dataset_manifest.dataset_name: HERMES Hardware-In-The-Loop Laboratory Benchmark + Synthetic Extension
dataset_manifest.soh_definition: Galvanostatic C/5 reference capacity test at 25C (Q_actual / Q_nominal)
